data.title: Fried Butter Daily
paragraphs: The satire desk at Content Cucumber. Everything below is invented, including the experts, the studies, the survey data, and the trade associations that keep issuing advisories nobody asked for.
We write about marketing the way marketing talks about itself, which turns out to require very little exaggeration.

data.title: The serious pages are elsewhere on this site
data.text: Content Cucumber writes content for commerce and SaaS brands, and writes it with people. This section is what those people do when nobody is watching.
